title: Balloting in the 2025 Secondary 1 Posting Exercise
asked: Ms Gho Sze Kee asked how many students went through balloting in the 2025 Secondary 1 Posting Exercise, how many of them missed out despite meeting the cut-off points of a higher choice, and how many students have been in that position each year since 2021.
response: Posting runs on merit, with students who score better in the PSLE getting priority for their preferred schools; ties are broken by citizenship status, then how the student ranked the school, then computerised balloting. In the 2025 exercise, around one in 10 students underwent computerised balloting, which the Minister said has been stable over recent years. MOE does not track how many students were unsuccessful despite meeting a school's cut-off point, and instead tracks top-choice placement: since 2021, more than eight in 10 students were posted to one of their top three choices and more than nine in 10 to one of their top six. On the supplementary questions, the Minister said cut-off points can vary by one to two points each year and that the Ministry will study the suggestions made.
